title: The five-cycle has no triangle
statement: The cycle graph $C_5$ on five vertices contains no clique of size $3$; that is, no three of its vertices are pairwise adjacent.
replaced:
\emph{The 5-cycle contains no clique of
three vertices.}

The 5-cycle (figure 7.2a) contains no clique of three vertices and no independent set of
three vertices. It shows, therefore, that \[r(3, 3) \geq 6 \qquad (7.8)\]
